summary: LEO AI Studio backend full pass — 23/23 pytest cases passed in 151s. Verified health, auth (401 paths + seeded-session 200), /api/generate input validation, all 5 modes (scene, video, text_video, audio, svg) across all 3 LLM engines (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro) with real Emergent LLM calls producing valid JSON/SVG, full gallery CRUD (create, list, mode filter, delete + verify gone), and strict per-user isolation (user B cannot see/delete user A's creations and vice-versa).

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of conventional 201 Created. Functional but non-idiomatic REST. No spec requirement was given, leaving as-is.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI ≥0.93).
POST /api/creations returns HTTP 200 — for a resource-creation endpoint, 201 Created is more idiomatic.
/api/generate has no per-user rate limiting or cost guard; an authenticated user can call the LLM indefinitely and burn EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget.
Generated LLM output is not size-bounded; very large responses are passed through to the client and saved into MongoDB documents (potential abuse vector & 16MB doc-size risk).

_strip_fences only handles ``` blocks; if an LLM ever wraps SVG in <html> or includes leading prose, downstream JSON.parse / SVG render will break. Consider a stricter post-validator that re-asks once on parse failure.
PROVIDER_MAP / MODE_SYSTEMS strings are long inline literals — moving to a `prompts.py` module would aid maintainability as modes/models grow.
Auth: BEARER token comparison is via direct DB lookup (good), but no logging of failed token attempts — adding lightweight audit logging would help spot brute-force probes.
seed_data_creation: Seeded TEST_userA@leo.ai and TEST_userB@leo.ai with valid sessions via /app/backend/tests/seed_test_users.py. Tokens stored at /tmp/leo_test_creds.json for reuse by the test suite. Test creations are prefixed with 'TEST ' and cleaned up in test_99_cleanup; remaining seed users are idempotent (re-running the script reuses existing user_ids).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run seed: `python /app/backend/tests/seed_test_users.py` then `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_leo_backend.py -v`. LLM tests are slow (~2-3 min total) because they hit real providers via emergentintegrations. If an LLM-mode test ever fails due to model output drift, inspect the raw 'raw' field in the response — _strip_fences may not catch new wrapper patterns. Cross-user isolation logic in DELETE relies on the {creation_id, user_id} compound filter in server.py:318 — keep that in any future refactor.
